Quaternius — Ultimate Animated Animal Pack (July 2021)
Horse.gltf and Cow.gltf, authored by Quaternius.
Source: https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimateanimatedanimals.html
Original public downloads: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1uJ3N5HfB7jKTseJUNQr3N4YaN0UuEtHk

Quaternius — Farm Animal Pack (June 2018)
Pig.fbx, authored by Quaternius.
Source: https://quaternius.com/packs/farmanimal.html
Original public downloads: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1is1ax2V0mIEDS7BbbzBV_x2Pabya1dVJ

Both packs are offered by their author under CC0 1.0 Universal.
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
These are stylised, rigged models; they are not photorealistic assets.
Pig uses its supplied idle animation with a custom additive leg gait.
Horse and cow use supplied idle, walk and eating clips. Horse also includes Gallop.

Three.js and example loaders/utilities: Copyright Three.js authors. MIT licence.
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r170/LICENSE

Farmer and female farmhand GLB assets: Quaternius Ultimate Modular Men / Women packs, CC0 1.0.
Original creator and licence listing: https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimatemodularcharacters.html
https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimatemodularcharacterswomen.html
GLB distribution mirror: https://github.com/nishit47/Blender-Pre-vis-Pipeline---Screenplay-to-Animatic/tree/main/assets
Farmer.glb and Animated Woman.glb downloaded 2 November 2026.
Original rigs and Idle_Neutral / Walk / Interact clips retained. Runtime materials adjusted for cloth; task props are original project art.
CC0: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

World expansion props (world8):
Kenney CC0 1.0: barrel and feed bag (Food Kit), hay bale (Graveyard Kit), crate (Platformer Kit), tablecloth table (Furniture Kit), market hall (City Kit Suburban), apple (Food Kit).
Original creator: https://kenney.nl/assets
Source GLB distribution: https://github.com/Hidencod/tge-assets (catalog links the original creator; CC0 1.0).
Lantern: Microsoft / sbtron (2017), CC0 1.0; Khronos glTF Sample Assets, Models/Lantern.
https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/tree/main/Models/Lantern
Lantern embedded PBR maps reduced from 2048 to 1024 pixels for mobile; geometry unchanged. No assets were purchased. Kenney props are authored stylized low-poly assets, not photorealistic HD replacements.
